main.description: A song shared on Khord, identified by ISRC for cross-platform resolution. Platform URLs are populated automatically via Odesli.

isrc.description: International Standard Recording Code — universal track identifier.

odesliKey.description: Odesli entity unique ID — can be used to re-resolve platform links.

thumbnailUrl.description: Album art thumbnail URL from Odesli (hosted on streaming CDN, not stored locally).

songlinkUrl.description: song.link page URL — aggregates all platform links (Odesli attribution).

note.description: Optional note from the person sharing the song.

listed.description: Whether this song should appear in the public feed. Defaults to true. Set to false for songs added directly to a setlist without sharing.

instanceUrl.description: URL of the Khord instance this song was shared from. Used for instance-scoped feed filtering.
